decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot closely builds on the firm's established automation and formwork know-how, so its strong absorptive capacity supports learning from early results and improving it rather than dropping it.
This automatic de-shuttering robot directly extends the firm's existing de-shuttering expertise, allowing the firm to assimilate early market feedback and refine the product.
The profile storage robot leverages the firm's in-house engineering and production control capabilities, giving the firm the relevant knowledge to interpret results and develop improvements.
The automatic shuttering robot builds on the firm's core shuttering and robotics competence, and its R&D experience enables the firm to absorb new information and enhance the product.
